tools.name: list_dhikr
tools.title: List dhikr phrases
tools.description: List every dhikr phrase supported by My Dhikr Companion, with its Arabic text, transliteration and English meaning.

tools.name: get_dhikr
tools.title: Get a dhikr phrase
tools.description: Get one dhikr phrase by id, including its Arabic text, transliteration, English meaning and the pronunciation variants the counter accepts.

id.description: Dhikr id. One of: astaghfirullah, la-ilaha-illallah, subhanallah, alhamdulillah, allahu-akbar

tools.name: count_dhikr_in_text
tools.title: Count dhikr in text
tools.description: Run the app's recognition matcher over a transcript and count complete, non-overlapping repetitions of a dhikr. Accepts Arabic script or Latin transliteration.

id.description: Dhikr id to count. One of: astaghfirullah, la-ilaha-illallah, subhanallah, alhamdulillah, allahu-akbar
